title: 第19章 叶擎空是皓月等等你刚刚说到了打架对吧第20章 少年天帝之威初成你只是知道自己要死了
slug: 三天大成了绝世剑仙童养夫
content_zh:
“仙儿，今天咱们练完剑之后还会去找七叔他们切磋的对吧？”他大眼睛眨啊眨，其中闪动着懵懂，无知，好奇，无辜，可怜巴巴的灵光。
洛珺仙莲步微微停顿，抿着粉唇，半晌之后是久久的无语。
“七叔他们最近有事情，出去历练了，所以你最近见不到了。”
“这样啊···”叶天澜瞪大了眼睛看着她。
目光怀疑。
你看我信吗？
洛珺仙默不作声，熟练的在广袖留仙裙里拔开了神识玉简。
这是爷爷特地给她传递信息的。
玲珑指头十分熟练的找到一个名为七叔的联系人。
闭着眼睛都能找到了。
“七叔，我过来演武场了。”
对面很快就有消息传来。
“是仙儿啊，哈哈哈，来的好啊，来陪七叔练练，看看你最近实力有没有长进，有没有偷懒啊。”
洛珺仙默默撤回了一条消息。
点击重新发送。
“七叔，是我们过来演武场了。”
对面回应。
“······”
“仙儿啊，叔最近想起来突然还有点事情，咱们改日再聚吧！”
【对方已下线】

洛珺仙脸色平淡的将消息玉简收了回去。
看样子七叔是真的又去忙了，居然直接就下线找不到人了。
还真是挺忙的。
叶天澜满脸憧憬的来到演武场，随后整个人直接就傻眼儿了。
那么大一个萧家，人呢！
他不信邪的转了一圈，发现除了几个四代后辈正在互相对练之外，竟然连一个三代子弟的影子都找不到！
偌大的演武场，就只有秋风吹过落叶之后，飘零在地的沙沙声响起。
他跟见了鬼似的来到一处对练的四代子弟面前，将其中一个十一二岁大的少年给拎了起来。
“喂，小屁孩儿，你们那些叔叔长辈呢？”
洛珺仙白皙的额头上浮现出三根黑线。
小屁孩儿···你叫谁呢。
后者抹了把鼻涕，呆滞满脸懵逼的看着面前长相清秀帅气，比自己还高出一点的“凶神恶煞”面孔。
“哇！是蓝天怪蜀黍来了，我们完蛋了！”
content_en:
"Xian'er, after we finish sword practice today, we will go to Uncle Qi and the others to spar, right?" His big eyes blinked, with a flash of ignorance, ignorance, curiosity, innocence, and pitifulness.
Luo Jun's immortal lotus steps paused slightly, pursed her pink lips, and remained speechless for a long time.
"Uncle Qi and the others have been busy recently and have gone out for training, so you haven't been able to see them recently."
"That's it..." Ye Tianlan looked at her with wide eyes.
Suspicious eyes.
Do you think I believe it?
Luo Junxian remained silent and skillfully pulled out the jade slip of divine consciousness from Liuxian's skirt with wide sleeves.
This was a message specially sent to her by her grandfather.
Linglongzhi very skillfully found a contact named Uncle Qi.
You can find it with your eyes closed.
"Uncle Qi, I'm here for the martial arts show."
News soon came from the other side.
"It's Xian'er, hahaha, you're good to come. Come practice with Uncle Qi to see if your strength has improved recently and if you are lazy."
Luo Junxian silently withdrew a message.
Click Resend.
"Uncle Qi, we are here to practice martial arts."
The other side responded.
"······"
"Xian'er, my uncle suddenly remembered that he had something else to do recently. Let's get together another day!"
[The other party is offline]
Luo Junxian took the message slip back with a calm expression.
It seemed that Uncle Qi was really busy again, and he actually went offline and couldn't find anyone.
It's really busy.
Ye Tianlan came to the martial arts arena with a look full of longing, and then he was dumbfounded.
What about the Xiao family, who are so big!
He turned around in disbelief and found that except for a few fourth-generation descendants who were sparring with each other, there was not even a third-generation descendant to be found!
In the huge martial arts field, the only sound that could be heard was the rustling of fallen leaves after the autumn wind blew through them.
As if he had seen a ghost, he came to a group of fourth-generation disciples who were sparring, and picked up an eleven or twelve-year-old boy among them.
"Hey, little brat, where are your uncles and elders?"
Three black lines appeared on Luo Junxian's fair forehead.
Little brat...who is your name?
The latter wiped his nose and looked blankly at the handsome and handsome face in front of him, which was a little taller than himself.
"Wow! The blue sky monster is here, we are doomed!"
